newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC signs $616 million deal with ICO.
newsitem.headline: NEC signs $616 million deal with ICO.

text.p: NEC Corp announced on Monday that it had signed a $616 million contract to supply ICO Global Communications with a global mobile satellite communications system.
NEC said that it, Hughes Network Systems of the United States, and Swedish telecoms group Ericsson would jointly build a ground system for ICO's communications network.
The ground system will be made up of 12 satellite access nodes (SANs), a network management centre and facilities to link the SANs and connect them to public switched networks, NEC said.
The whole ground system will be completed by August 2000, NEC said.

ICO was set up by 47 investors worldwide in 1994 to develop the International Mobile Satellite Organisation's (Inmarsat) satellite-based mobile telephone system. Inmarsat is a multinational cooperative based in London.
ICO will launch commercial service in 2000, NEC said.
